newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 8.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 8.

text.p: These are the main headlines reported by Latvian state radio on Tuesday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.

- PM Andris Shkele told the Fatherland and Freedom faction he was not satisfied with Economy Minister Guntar Krasts' remarks in the row over the privatisation posta which Shkele discredited the privatisation process.
- A bomb was found in the headquarters of Latvenergo but no prior threats or warnings were received.

- Latvian Foreign Minister Valdis Birkavs meets deputy Russian foreign minister Igor Ivanov in Moscow to talk on a planned April meeting, the first of its kind, between the Latvian-Russian intergovernment committee set up two years ago.
- A delegation from Daugavpils, the second largest town, arrives in Moscow to prepare for a trade exhibition in April.
